newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber SIR20 unchanged in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber SIR20 unchanged in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in slow late trading on Thursday, with no deals heard, dealers said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices remained at 55.25-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 55.00-55.25 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang as well as at 54.50-55.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"There are only few active dealers in the market," one dealer said, adding there were bids at 54.00 fob Medan but there were no deals heard as sellers refused to lower their offer prices.
